_comment_capture_harnesses: The workflow-completion capture harness descends from the subagent-completion one (the same bounded-scroll-region defect class, fixed card by card, each PR single-purpose by policy), and the Azure DevOps one descends from capture-issue-radar-fixes.mjs -- it shares that file's gateway-free fixture-server preamble and its boot-endpoint block, which is what makes an Issue Radar surface capturable without a gateway at all. The active-forge harness descends from the same file for the same reason: it serves the built SPA from the identical loopback preamble and answers the identical boot endpoints, driving the localStorage active-repo pointer instead of the provider query so the resolved forge is what gets photographed. The md-edit-label harness descends from capture-pierre-files-tab.mjs the same way: it reuses that file's probe assertion and frame-recording blocks against a different surface (the file viewer's mode toggle). The long-url-linkify harness descends from capture-cjk-autolink.mjs -- the same markdown-tokenization defect class photographed through the same fixture-served chat bubble, against a different linkify defect. The files above are exempt BY FILE, not by directory: the originals they descend from, and every other capture/script file, stay checked. Sharing a runner was considered and rejected -- each harness is a one-shot evidence generator pinned to its own card's testid, fixture, and assertions, and coupling them would make the next card's fix re-touch a merged PR's files. The chatpane-upload-error harness descends from capture-chatpane-queue-edit.mjs (same ChatPane fixture preamble against a different composer defect), and the aws-control harness descends from capture-hero-art-proxy.mjs (same gateway-free boot-endpoint block against a different surface); each pair completed in PRs that crossed in review, so neither PR's own CI saw the finished clone. The terminal-reconnect harness descends from capture-terminal-paste-key.mjs -- the same static-dist terminal preamble driven to the disconnected state instead of a clipboard action. The terminal-copy-key harness descends from capture-terminal-paste-key.mjs -- the same static-dist terminal preamble (scripted echo PTY, touch emulation, clipboard grant) photographing the Copy half of the touch-clipboard asymmetry that PR's Paste key left open. The declined-reinvestigate harness descends from copy-link-feedback.tsx -- the same preamble mounting the real IssueDetail inside the real IssueRadarProvider with only `fetch` stubbed, photographing a different defect in the same header (why a re-investigate was declined) instead of the overflow menu's copy confirmation. The grid-divider-align harness descends from capture-sidebar-dragbar.mjs -- the same prepareSplitChatPage/serveDist fixture preamble and seeded split panes, photographing the sibling instance of the same accent-bar-overshoots-rounded-corners defect (the split-view divider between panes) that capture-sidebar-dragbar.mjs left open for the sidebar resize handle. The prose-diff-fold harness is exempt for the payload, not the shape: it was deliberately rewritten as a fixture DATA TABLE rather than the if-chain capture-diff-render.mjs uses, which is what removed the 462-token clone against that file -- what remains is the boot-endpoint payload itself (the kiro-prerequisite readiness object and its neighbours), which every harness must answer identically for the SPA to leave the setup chapter at all, and which therefore matches whichever sibling was written last (currently capture-user-message-touch-actions.mjs). The crew-inline-schedule harness descends from capture-crew-diagram-node-nav.mjs -- the same gateway-free crew-editor preamble (fixture crews, stubbed editor endpoints, open the oncall sheet) driven to the schedules pane's inline create form and its narrow-viewport and discard-confirm states instead of the overview diagram's hover affordances. Remove an entry here the moment its file stops matching its sibling.
_comment_crew_companion: Crew Companion and Mochi are two separately-shippable companion apps that descend from the same desktop-buddy codebase, so the files listed below start as near-copies of Mochi's. They are exempt BY FILE, not by directory: every other file in crew-companion is still checked, and any new file added there is checked from the moment it exists. Sharing this layer was considered and rejected -- each app is enabled, disabled and versioned on its own, and the two are expected to diverge (Mochi is agentic, Crew Companion paces your day), so a shared module would couple two products that deliberately ship apart. Remove an entry here the moment its file stops matching Mochi's.
